title: Relabeling work symbols in a machine
statement: Given a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with alphabet $[1mSymbol[0m$ and a bijection $e$ of that alphabet, define a machine over the same alphabet and state set with the same initial state. Its transition first translates each scanned work-tape symbol back along $e$, applies the original transition, and then relabels every symbol that the action writes on a work tape by $e$; all other parts of the action are preserved.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A deterministic multi-tape Turing machine over an alphabet and state set
A bijection of the symbol alphabet
